title.zh: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients
title.en: Standard Chartered unlocks direct bitcoin and ether trading for affluent UAE clients

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered launched a first-of-its-kind-in-the-UAE crypto trading service letting affluent, professional-investor clients buy and sell bitcoin and ether directly through bank accounts, with custody and settlement handled in-house via a closed-loop model.
current_state.en: Standard Chartered launched a first-of-its-kind-in-the-UAE crypto trading service letting affluent, professional-investor clients buy and sell bitcoin and ether directly through bank accounts, with custody and settlement handled in-house via a closed-loop model.
